contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP AVG GER DAC P M TR P COS V P P ; R/ S P Q R OPTIMO PRINCIPI

Denarius of Trajan dating from AD103-111. Mint or issue place: Rome. Obverse description: laureate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP AVG GER DAC P M TR P COS V P P. Reverse description: Dacian in peaked cap on a shield, mourning, with a curved sword below him. Reverse inscription: S P Q R OPTIMO PRINCIPI. RIC Identifier: RIC II Trajan 219
